action_args.content: BREAKING: we are thinking to launch boba in pepsi in melbourne
As a Director of Market Defense, my reaction to this news: Skeptical - views boba Pepsi as a gimmick that could dilute the carbonated soft drink category they dominate.
As a Founder & Chief Brand Officer, my reaction to this news: Skeptical - worries mass-market boba Pepsi will cheapen the category and confuse environmentally conscious consumers.
As a Leasing and Activation Manager, my reaction to this news: Neutral - willing to host the launch if it drives traffic, but indifferent to the product itself.
